# Glossary {.unnumbered}

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Correspondence | Agreement between the commanded and proved state of equipment, particularly points. |
| Fail-safe | A design approach in which foreseeable failures tend to result in, or reveal themselves through, a safe state. |
| Interlocking | The system that prevents incompatible or unsafe signalling commands from being simultaneously authorised. |
| Normal / Reverse | Defined reference positions used for points and associated controls. |
| Route | A defined path through the signalling system for a train movement. |
